affirm.note: Founders Fund entered at the $100M Series D, distinct from Thiel's personal earlier involvement (D2). Replaced historical float with current market cap.

airbnb.note: Founders Fund led the $200M Series C in 2012, publicly confirmed in October 2013. Current market cap replaces historical float.

anduril.note: FF led the 2017 seed. Closed H establishes graduation; later fundraising talks are not a new mark.

funding_rounds.round: Unspecified financing (counsel PDF says Series C; current article omits label)

arq.note: DolarApp renamed Arq, not acquired. March 2026 $70M FF/Sequoia financing has no disclosed valuation. Counsel's PDF calls it Series C but its current article removes the round label; vendors call it A. Entry left undetermined on conflicting labels.

asana.note: FF entered the $28M Series B, not Thiel's personal seed. Close date from Form D; announcement July 23. Market cap replaces float.

aven.note: Company's July 2024 Series D explicitly calls FF an existing investor, so D is not asserted as entry. Earlier fund round not established. September 2025 company-announced Series E sets $2.2B mark.

funding_rounds.lead: United Arab Emirates and affiliated investment entities

boring-company.note: FF participated in the 2022 Series C. September 2026 closed $3B financing supersedes $5.675B mark.

buildops.note: Commercial contractor software, not Buildots. FF joins named $43M Series A; company's $127M Series C announcement sets $1B valuation.

cedar.note: US patient-billing Cedar, not Japanese namesake. FF joins $13M Series A. Last disclosed primary mark is March 2021 $3.2B; stale. Careportal legal-issuer duplicate to merge.

funding_rounds.lead: Andreessen Horowitz, Accel, Founders Fund, General Catalyst and Avenir

cognition.note: Company names FF-led $21M Series A. September 2026 $2B Series E sets $48B mark.

credit-karma.note: Acq. by Intuit, December 2020; no standalone current value. FF Angel joined November 2009 A, but vendor history also places FF in an October 2008 seed, not independently labelled in found press; first entry unresolved.

funding_rounds.lead: Bain Capital Ventures and Founders Fund Pathfinder
Atreides Management, Mubadala Capital and Valor Equity Partners

crusoe.note: FF Pathfinder co-led the 2019 seed. The 2024 director-anchored filing is later, not entry. Series F initial close supplies the current primary mark and establishes graduation.

deepmind.note: Acq. by Google, 2014. Derik Pridmore's Osaro presentation identifies his Founders Fund role and DeepMind Series A leadership; indexed PDF text survives but full-document web fetch exceeds size limit.

endurosat.note: FF entered May 2025 Series B (EUR43M, contemporaneous press USD49M). September 2026 $205M raise exceeds $1B per company spokesperson: stored $1B is a disclosed lower bound, not an exact mark. | September 2026 $205M financing: spokesperson says valuation exceeded $1B but declines the figure. Under Rule A's MatX precedent this does not mint a $1B floor as valuation_usd; prior floor withdrawn. Below_1b is the source-gated band, not a denial of reported unicorn status. Same reading as GV's independently documented check.

enter.note: Brazilian legal-AI Enter, not defunct Russian retailer. FF co-led September 2025 A, then May 2026 B at $1.2B.

funding_rounds.lead: Greylock Partners and Meritech Capital Partners

facebook.note: Meta Platforms. Fund entry was the 2006 Series B, not Thiel's 2004 personal angel check (D2) or the 2014 acquisition-related filing. Current market cap replaces float.

funding_rounds.lead: Lightspeed Venture Partners and Y Combinator
Lightspeed Venture Partners and Founders Fund

faire.note: Company identified FF as a new investor in the combined 2018 B/C financing. The priced 2025 employee tender supersedes the stale $12.59B mark, not an indicative secondary quote.

figma.note: FF joined 2019 Series C; Thiel Fellowship was not a fund seed. Current NYSE market cap replaces zero pre-IPO float.

flexport.note: FF led the 2015 A, before the 2019 filing anchor. The 2024 Shopify financing was an uncapped note, not a fresh priced valuation. Vendor secondary estimates do not replace the stale 2022 primary mark.

flock-safety.note: FF participates in December 2018 Series A-1 announcement, distinct from Lewis's Bedrock role. Company told Fortune it raised $500M at $8.3B; as-of is report date, exact close not stated.

fortell.note: AI hearing-aid company. Public report confirms FF backing and $163M funding, but no first-round label. Forge's $740M July 2026 mark is vendor-only, not a published value.

found.note: Found.com small-business banking, not Found weight-loss service. FF entered $60M Series B. June 2024 $50M C confirmed; vendor $406M mark not minted.

general-matter.note: FF-incubated nuclear-fuel company. First pre-launch fund check not publicly labelled; 2025 round called Series A in later history. March 2026 $500M at $2B pre-money was fundraising, not a completed mark; DOE/EXIM commitments are not equity valuations.

funding_rounds.lead: Lux Capital, Founders Fund and Construct Capital

hadrian.note: 2021 seed entry supersedes the later filing anchor; company retrospectively labels seed and announces A/A-prime graduation.

impulse.note: Impulse Space, not cookware namesake. FF led March 2022 seed; later named Series D establishes graduation. September 2026 extension priced at $5.6B.

funding_rounds.lead: D1 Capital Partners, Founders Fund, Ribbit Capital and BOND
Andreessen Horowitz and WCM Investment Management

kavak.note: FF joined the $485M Series D, closed January 2021 and announced April. March 2025 equity financing repriced Kavak to $2.2B; the February 2026 Series F disclosed no replacement valuation.

lighter.note: Counsel identifies the $68M financing as Series B and separately confirms FF/Ribbit's participation and $1.5B fully diluted valuation. Equity with token warrants, not a token-only entry. Founder Novakovski pivoted Lunchclub into Lighter; prior 2024 round named other investors.

lyft.note: FF's $15M Series B closed in 2012 and was reported January 2013; earlier personal angels and fbFund grant do not establish FF entry. Current cap replaces prefill.

mnzil.note: Workforce-housing operator, outside the closed focus taxonomy. Company and published press release give SAR44M ($11.7M), not the $44M mistranscription. FF's first Saudi investment; no disclosed billion-dollar priced event.

monaco.note: Co-investor Mishpacha dates its seed with FF to January 2025. FF led both $10M seed and $25M A, not only the announced A; named later A establishes graduation. No disclosed billion-dollar mark.

nanotronics.note: Now CubeFabs per the redirected official site. FF's entry was the 2013 $7M B, not the 2015 banded A. No priced $1B event found; vendor and portfolio-fund marks not admitted.

netic.note: Bloomberg explicitly names FF in Greylock-led seed and subsequent A/B; $450M priced Series B. Seed year from published chronology (https://www.linkedin.com/posts/rorybernier_female-led-ai-startup-netic-raises-23m-series-activity-7395302436564803584-bVz4), corroborated by vendor September 2024; exact close not pinned. Cybernetic Labs Inc., Melisa Tokmak, not UK Cybernetic Labs Ltd/Ahmed Elshalaby. New-round check October 2 found no later priced mark.

neuralink.note: FF participated in 2021 Series C, before leading 2023 D. $9B pre-money reported by Semafor plus company-confirmed $650M Series E = $9.65B post-money, within 5% of $10B edge. Secondary quotes not used. Current company job application explicitly identifies Austin as HQ, superseding Fremont filing address.

nominal.note: Hardware test-data platform, not the accounting namesake. Counsel confirms FF in $7.5M seed then $20M A. Lux dates investment to 2022 (https://www.luxcapital.com/companies/Nominal); company-maintained Wellfound profile dates seed November 2022 and A December 2023. April 2024 was public announcement, not entry.

nubank.note: Nu Holdings is public, not the acquired namesake. Company's own funding history places first FF participation in January 2016 Series C, after seed/A/B led by other firms.

oculus.note: Oculus VR, not the public Latvian namesake. Facebook's 2014 annual report confirms acquisition completed July 2014; no current standalone value.

openai.note: FF first invested through the April 2023 tender, distinct from Thiel personally. March 2026 company-announced close supplies the current post-money valuation.

oscar.note: Oscar Health, not the Ukraine namesake. FF led the January 2014 A, but evidence also places it in the 2013 financing; the earliest round label remains unresolved after site, funding-history and prospectus searches. Do not substitute the later A for entry.

palantir.note: Moved HQ to Miami in February 2026. The 2009 banded A cannot establish first fund entry: reporting mixes Thiel's founder financing and fund participation. Later led D is confirmed, but earliest fund-money round remains unresolved (D2).

paxos.note: FF joined the July 2021 Series D extension as a new strategic investor. Company's $2.4B primary mark remains stale; the 2026 $12M vendor item is not established as a new Paxos equity valuation.

persona.note: US identity-verification platform, not acquired Russian namesake. FF first led the Series C; the company's Series B names Index and Coatue, not FF. Current Series D mark is $2B.

polymarket.note: First FF round was May 2024 Series B. April 2026 closed round at $15B replaces 2025 ICE mark. August 31 reporting describes a planned $21B financing, not a completed close, so it is not substituted.

postmates.note: FF's March 2013 $5M Series A follows seed rounds naming other investors. Uber completed acquisition December 1, 2020. Vator's indexed historical chronology names the A; its live URL now returns 404.

psiquantum.note: Vendor histories place FF at September 2017 $50M B, not 2016 A, but no non-vendor entry-round citation found after firm/company/press searches, so stage remains undetermined. Reuters confirms $7B September 2025 primary; Sacra's claimed May 2026 $10.5B round is uncorroborated and not used.

ramp.note: US spend-management Ramp, not Ramp Network. Partner-anchored seed close retained; August coverage confirms FF participation. Named Series C independently establishes graduation. June 2026 primary updates the mark.

rippling.note: FF led the $145M Series B in 2020. Company's migrated post has a March 2024 update timestamp, not the round date. May 2025 Series G supplies the $16.8B primary mark.

river.note: River Technologies, Sai Mattapalli's custom-software services for financial institutions, not River Financial or River AI. Founder dates seed to a few months before summer 2026 update, followed by $3.5M extension; company calls total $9.5M seed. No named A; within censor window. Bespoke services are outside the closed focus taxonomy.

funding_rounds.lead: Fifty Years, Founders Fund and Y Combinator
Kinnevik, Lowercarbon Capital and Refactor Capital

solugen.note: Company timeline identifies FF as co-lead of the 2018 A, before the 2019 B filing anchor. 2022 D mark is stale; subsequent DOE debt is not a new equity price.

space-exploration-technologies-corp.note: Same issuer as site row spacex, merge pending. Public SPCX since June 2026; current HQ Starbase. FF's $20M August 2008 entry is verified, but non-vendor sources do not consistently label its round; neither first institutional nor a later filing may invent a stage.

spotify.note: Public, not acquired; operational HQ Stockholm overrides Luxembourg registered office. 2010 C predates filing anchor. Cap lies 0.2% above the $100B edge.

twilio.note: Entry date corrected to March seed; December filing is A graduation, confirmed by company. Current market cap replaces historical float.

varda.note: Seed entry despite the oversized-seed A band. Space-based pharmaceutical processing, now at a priced Series D; current HQ replaces the initial filing address.

workrise.note: Rebranded back to RigUp. FF led the 2014 seed and joined the 2016 A; 2021 filing is not entry. Last priced primary mark remains stale.

zocdoc.note: FF entered at B, not Khosla's 2008 A. May 2026 company announcement proposes a $2.3B employee tender but explicitly says it has not commenced; pending terms do not replace the last completed priced mark.
